lead: Glass terrarium measuring 60x35x40 cm with a handmade 3D background. Volume: 84.0 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: The 60x35x40 cm terrarium has 2100 cm² of floor, 40 cm of height and 84 liters. The back is covered by a 3D styrofoam background in the shape of rock or bark. At 40 cm high it has more air space than the other 60 cm long models. Ventilation is through mesh vents, and we cover the outer sides with film.

That height is best used by a growing corn snake, which readily climbs the background and branches. A young ball python gets two hides some forty centimeters apart. Young tortoises do well on the floor, and the background serves them only as cover. For an adult bearded dragon the floor is too small, so only a juvenile can live here.

When you come to need a longer terrarium with a background, our range has the 80x40x45 and 90x45x45. We agree the shape of the background before the build, and we also make other dimensions to order. The lead time is 7 to 14 days. We ship the finished terrarium with its background by courier.
